Roy Keane leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드 by mutual consent, ending his 12-year association with the club.

The Edmonton Eskimos defeat the Montreal Alouettes 38-35 in the 93rd Grey Cup Canadian Football League championship at B.C. Place Stadium in Vancouver, British Columbia . The Eskimos won in overtime on a Sean Fleming field goal to capture their 13th Grey Cup in franchise history. Eskimos quarterback Ricky Ray was named Grey Cup MVP. (Game Coverage)

November ends with 첼시 still top of the Premier League, their nearest contenders now being 맨체스터 유나이티드 who are 10 points behind and with a game in hand. 아스널, 위건 애슬레틱 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 complete the top five. 선덜랜드 remain bottom with a mere five points and one win so far, with 버밍엄 시티 and 포츠머스 completing the bottom three. In the Championship, Reading have overtaken 셰필드 유나이티드 with a four-point advantage. 왓퍼드, Leeds, Luton and Cardiff complete the top six, while Crewe, Brighton and 밀월 remain in the relegation zone.
